faq.title: Common questions
faq.home.1.q: How do I book a doctor on Kiorex?
faq.home.1.a: Search or pick a specialty, open a profile, choose one of the live time slots and confirm. You see the slot before you book, and the booking is confirmed by the clinic system.
faq.home.2.a: Doctors appear on Kiorex only after their clinic connects to Kiorex and the listing is switched on. Reviews come from patients who booked through Kiorex.
faq.home.3.q: What should I do in an emergency?
faq.home.3.a: Call 123 (ambulance). Kiorex is for planned appointments and is not an emergency service.
faq.list.1.q: How do I choose between these doctors?
faq.list.1.a: Compare fees, languages, ratings and the next free slot shown on each card, then open a profile for the full details.
faq.list.2.a: Fees shown are indicative and come from the clinic. The price and the slot are confirmed when you book.
faq.list.3.q: Can I book in Arabic or English?
faq.list.3.a: Yes. Every page is available in both languages, and each profile lists the languages the doctor speaks.
faq.care.1.q: How does a home visit get booked?
faq.care.1.a: Choose a provider that covers your district, pick a time and add your address in the app. The address is shared only with the assigned provider.
faq.care.2.a: Each provider lists the districts they cover. The district pages show only providers that cover that district.
faq.care.3.q: What if the situation is urgent?
faq.care.3.a: Call 123 (ambulance). Home visits are planned appointments and are not an emergency service.
faq.location.1.q: How do I find the right doctor here?
faq.location.1.a: Start from a specialty in the list above, or browse every provider on this page and compare their fees, languages and next free slot.
faq.location.2.q: Do these providers take bookings online?
faq.location.2.a: Yes. Every provider listed here has a live calendar connected to Kiorex, so you can book a confirmed slot without calling.
faq.location.3.q: What if I need urgent care?
faq.location.3.a: Call 123 (ambulance). Kiorex is for planned appointments and is not an emergency service.
faq.sameDay.1.a: A doctor appears here when their calendar shows a free slot within the next 24 hours. Slots are taken as people book, so confirm the time when you choose it.
faq.sameDay.2.q: What if no slot suits me?
faq.sameDay.2.a: Open the broader specialty page to see every doctor and their next free slot, or join a waitlist from a profile when it is offered.
faq.sameDay.3.q: Is same-day booking suitable for emergencies?
faq.sameDay.3.a: No. For an emergency call 123 (ambulance). Same-day booking is for planned care that cannot wait for next week.
faq.tele.1.a: A scheduled visit with the doctor over video, booked and paid like any other appointment on Kiorex. Only doctors who offer video are listed on this page.
faq.tele.2.q: What do I need to join?
faq.tele.2.a: A phone or computer with a camera, microphone and an internet connection. You join from your booking in the app at the time of the visit.
faq.tele.3.q: Can every problem be handled by video?
faq.tele.3.a: No. The doctor decides during the visit and may ask you to come in person. For an emergency call 123 (ambulance).
faq.doctor.1.q: How do I book an appointment?
faq.doctor.1.a: Use the booking button on this page, choose one of the live slots and confirm. You receive a confirmation in the app.
faq.doctor.2.a: The fee shown is indicative and comes from the clinic. The final price and the slot are confirmed when you book.
faq.doctor.3.q: What if I need urgent care?
faq.doctor.3.a: Call 123 (ambulance). Kiorex is for planned appointments and is not an emergency service.
faq.nurse.1.q: How do I book a home visit?
faq.nurse.1.a: Use the booking button, choose a time and add your address in the app. The address is shared only with the assigned nurse.
faq.nurse.2.a: The districts this provider covers are listed on this page. If yours is not listed, check the district pages for other providers.
faq.nurse.3.q: What if the situation is urgent?
faq.nurse.3.a: Call 123 (ambulance). Home visits are planned appointments and are not an emergency service.
faq.clinic.1.q: Can I book any doctor at this clinic online?
faq.clinic.1.a: Yes. Each doctor listed here has a live calendar connected to Kiorex, so you can book a confirmed slot without calling.
faq.clinic.2.q: Where do the reviews come from?
faq.clinic.2.a: Reviews come from patients who booked through Kiorex and are shown after moderation.
faq.pharmacy.1.a: You can send the e-prescriptions issued through Kiorex. The pharmacy confirms what it can supply when it receives the order.
faq.pharmacy.2.a: Only the pharmacy you choose receives the order, and only for the time needed to prepare it.
faq.lab.1.q: Do I need a request from a doctor?
faq.lab.1.a: Book the tests your doctor requested through Kiorex. The lab tells you if a test needs preparation, such as fasting.
faq.lab.2.q: Where do I see the result?
faq.lab.2.a: In the Kiorex app, as soon as the lab publishes it.
